source.provider: California Academy of Sciences, Department of Ichthyology
source.rightsCaveat: GBIF dataset metadata displays CC0-1.0. The provider portal search is a second source check, not a separate permission grant; app publication remains unapproved.

purpose: Cross-check the twelve new GBIF-indexed Molawin Creek CAS records against the provider's public collection portal by catalog number and collection code, then compare provider taxon labels and locality fields.

query.providerHelpSemantics: The CAS help page says catalog-number searches return integer lots and the collection code identifies CAS versus Stanford (SU) records. The same catalog numbers therefore must not be matched without checking the collection code.
query.resultSelection: The response contains twelve CAS-SU records that match the GBIF catalog numbers, Philippines, Laguna and College of Agriculture locality. Provider taxon names agree except for Dermogenys viviparus versus the GBIF-indexed Dermogenys vivipara spelling. The other twelve are CAS-ICH lots with colliding catalog numbers from unrelated localities.

records.nameDifference: GBIF source string ends in vivipara; provider collection record displays viviparus. Preserve both; no specimen re-identification is inferred.

records.dateConflict: The 1940-10-17 collection date conflicts with 1941 in the collector's field number; preserve both. No date correction is made.

sharedProviderFields.georeferenceInterpretation: Generalized UPLB campus point whose provider note says the polygon includes Molawin Creek; not an exact capture point. Coordinates are intentionally not copied into this artifact.

decision.reason: All twelve GBIF record IDs cross-match CAS-SU provider lots by catalog number and collection code; Philippines, Laguna and College of Agriculture locality fields corroborate the candidate lots. The provider also supplies waterBody=Molawin Creek and date/field-number values. A generalized 809 m campus georeference, a name-ending difference for Dermogenys vivipara/viviparus, the Microphis jagorii date/field-number conflict and unresolved independent taxonomy prevent specimen re-identification or public point/species admission.
nonClaims: A source-reported waterBody value and generalized campus georeference do not establish an exact capture point or current fish presence.
The 12 lots are not a complete Molawin Creek checklist, abundance estimate, or independent survey count.
Catalog-number matches without collection code can return unrelated CAS-ICH records; preserve the CAS-SU code in every crosswalk.
CC0 shown by GBIF metadata does not approve a public app row or resolve other provider-specific reuse conditions.
